cards.t: Binance Sets Aside $6.34B to Cover Losses
cards.b: Binance executives announced that the exchange has set aside $6.34 billion of its own funds to fully cover user losses resulting from the recent security breach, alongside roughly $3 billion frozen by industry partners.

per.BNB: Aimed to stabilize market confidence after initial sharp sell-offs following the hack.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact proof-of-reserves publication details confirming the replenishment of shortfalls.

cards.b: Binance suffered a historic security breach resulting in approximately $6.3 billion in stolen funds across multiple blockchains, causing market-wide liquidations and token price drops.

per.BNB: Faced downward pressure, dropping around 7% to 8% following the exchange breach.
per.BTC: Slid below $77,000 as large amounts of stolen bitcoin were moved and traced into separate wallets.
per.ETH: Implicated as attackers utilized EIP-7702 delegation features to drain funds and bypass withdrawal controls.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full recovery timeline and complete identification of all compromised internal infrastructure.

cards.t: Polymarket Suspends Trading Following Third-Party Breach
cards.b: Polymarket temporarily suspended trading and placed its exchange in cancel-only mode after a third-party provider suffered a security incident that led to user account drains.

per.POL: Impacted by suspicious outflows and attacker wallet balances tied to the breach.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full details on the exact third-party provider compromised and total restitution plans.

cards.t: Canary Capital Proposes Staked INJ ETF with Nasdaq Listing Shift
cards.b: Canary Capital shifted its proposed staked INJ ETF listing to Nasdaq, featuring a 1.10% fee and a $15 million seed from the Injective Foundation while awaiting final trading approval.

per.INJ: Stands to benefit from regulated institutional access and staking rewards via the proposed exchange-traded fund.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact SEC approval and launch dates.

cards.t: Morgan Stanley Launches Spot Bitcoin ETF
cards.b: Morgan Stanley officially launched its spot Bitcoin ETF, which debuted with $30.6 million in early inflows.

per.BTC: Gained supportive institutional demand from the newly debuted product.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Sustained long-term inflow volumes relative to competitors.
